backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user-authenticated CRUD for prompts and categories with access control and profile management.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing feature evidence, related files, components, and test IDs for multiple app features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries for various frontend source files, documenting their purpose and behavior.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide providing steps and checks for diagnosing and resolving deployment failures.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point loading the React app and defining favicon links.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Primary application component handling authentication state, UI layout, prompt filtering/sorting, and backend sync.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Sign-in screen component prompting users to authenticate via Internet Identity with styled UI elements.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: Displays a favorites toggle and a scrollable list of category badges, allowing selection or deselection of a category.
Lets users add new categories and select multiple existing ones via checkboxes, updating the parent on changes.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog for renaming or deleting categories, showing usage counts and confirming deletions.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Provides import and export controls for prompts and categories, handling file input and backend sync.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Generic confirmation dialog with cancel and continue actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Renders copy, favorite, duplicate, edit, and delete actions for a prompt with tooltips.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Displays sanitized HTML prompt content safely using dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Dialog for creating or editing prompts with fields for title, content, categories, and favorite status.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Shows prompts in a responsive card grid with previews, categories, and action controls.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: Renders prompts in a card-based list with categories, actions, and content preview.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Displays a modal dialog showing full prompt content and title.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Shows prompts in a sortable table with categories, dates, actions, and a preview dialog.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Provides a search input field with icon and change handling.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown component for selecting prompt sorting modes.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: Toggle buttons for switching between list, grid, and table prompt views.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Handles Internet Identity logout flow, URL validation, logout URL construction, and redirect navigation.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Returns the specific post-logout URL containing the required admin token hash.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: Hook coordinating reliable Internet Identity logout by clearing local state then triggering provider logout.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: API wrapper mapping frontend prompt data to backend types and providing CRUD operations.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: Syncs prompts and categories with backend on authentication and wraps backend persistence actions.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category strings with add, rename, delete, and reset operations including case‑insensitive checks.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: Hook providing a copy function using the Clipboard API with fallbacks and a temporary copied state.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories as a JSON file with metadata using a generated Blob download.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports and validates prompt data from a JSON file, resolving ID collisions and returning prompts and categories.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines export data structure and validates imported prompt objects for required fields.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and case‑insensitive text search across multiple fields.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates unique prompt IDs using timestamps and random strings.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store handling prompt CRUD, duplication, favorites, category updates, and full list management.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Sorts prompts by date, title, edit time, or favorite status based on a selected mode.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Type definitions for prompts, view modes, and supported sort modes.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Converts HTML content to cleaned plain text by stripping tags and collapsing whitespace.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Sanitizes pasted HTML, keeping safe tags and color styling while removing unsupported elements.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: Rich text editor component supporting bold, italic, colors, HTML sanitization, and controlled updates.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves minimal UI preferences, specifically view mode, to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: Hook persisting view mode changes to localStorage and loading initial prefs on mount.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context/provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and tracking login status.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes with global styles for background, text, and borders.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op function kept for backward compatibility after favicon handling moved to static link tags.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based parameter handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, fonts, and plugins using custom CSS variable-based color definitions.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current state, features, issues, and requirements for the Prompt Library app.
